sectors.trend: Gold equities outperforming on safe-haven demand amid Iran conflict; copper and lithium exploration activity continues; iron ore muted by China solar transition
sectors.implications: Gold miners (AUR.AX, GWN.AX, KRG.AX) benefit from geopolitical premium; copper (TNR.AX) and lithium (ZNL.AX, CHT.AX) remain in exploration phase with no near-term revenue; BHP.AX/RIO.AX face headwind from Chinese solar overtaking coal

sectors.trend: Mortgage stress at 18-year highs pressures NIMs and credit losses; CBA fee controversy damages brand; RBA rate-hike fears compress valuations
sectors.implications: CBA.AX, NAB.AX, ANZ.AX, WBC.AX face rising NPL provisions and margin pressure; rate hike may support NIMs but credit cycle deterioration offsets; property developer defaults (Bathla) raise construction-loan risk

sectors.trend: Oil spikes toward $100 on US-Iran strikes and Persian Gulf tanker fires; Tasmanian power station fire disrupts supply; coal-to-solar transition accelerates in China
sectors.implications: WDS.AX, WLE.AX, SXG.AX benefit from oil spike; coal assets (BHP.AX thermal) face structural demand decline; renewable/infrastructure names gain policy tailwind

sectors.trend: Qantas strike vote threatens operations; US construction spending near three-year low signals global demand softness; retail theft and small-business stress noted
sectors.implications: QAN.AX faces operational disruption risk; consumer discretionary names under pressure from per-capita recession; WES.AX, WOW.AX relatively resilient

sectors.trend: Developer implosions (Bathla, 'Evergrande moment'); 10% house-price decline forecast; housing affordability crisis deepens
sectors.implications: REITs (GPW.AX, ICPS.AX) face rising discount rates if RBA hikes; construction and property developers at elevated default risk; mortgage-backed securities under stress

sectors.trend: Meta AI model release and Citi tech-buy signal support global tech; but Iran conflict 'bombs AI bubble' narrative; Apple/OpenAI disputes add noise
sectors.implications: ASX tech (WTC.AX, XRO.AX, SVL.AX) tracks US sentiment; AI capex cycle intact but geopolitical risk creates volatility; Canva (CVA - private) privacy litigation a minor overhang

key_themes: Geopolitical escalation (US-Iran, Persian Gulf) driving oil and safe-haven flows
RBA rate-hike risk vs. stalling growth – policy dilemma intensifies
Housing credit cycle turning: 18-year mortgage stress, developer defaults
Productivity deterioration undermining medium-term growth narrative
Energy transition accelerating (China solar > coal) reshaping commodity demand
Trade fragmentation: Trump-Canada tariffs, global bond selloff

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Oil price spike to $100+ from US-Iran conflict
risk_assessment.mitigation: Hedge energy exposure; favour oil producers (WDS.AX, WLE.AX) over refiners; monitor AUD/USD as oil-driven inflation pressures RBA

risk_assessment.risk_factor: RBA fourth rate hike triggering housing correction
risk_assessment.mitigation: Reduce REIT and property developer exposure; favour cash-rich banks with strong capital buffers; monitor mortgage stress data weekly
Avoid speculative property equities; monitor bank construction-loan provisions; favour established developers with secured debt
Favour dividend-paying defensives (WES.AX, WBC.AX); underweight growth/consumer discretionary
Reduce QAN.AX position or hedge; monitor for operational disruption to tourism and freight

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Global bond selloff and rising yields
risk_assessment.mitigation: Shorten duration in fixed income; favour floating-rate notes; monitor 10Y AUS bond yield as proxy for RBA path

opportunities.recommendation: Overweight gold miners on geopolitical safe-haven bid
opportunities.rationale: Iran conflict, $100 oil, and global uncertainty support gold; multiple WA discoveries (Gateway, King River) and Auric's $28M profit confirm sector momentum

opportunities.recommendation: Tactical long on oil & gas producers
opportunities.rationale: Persian Gulf tanker fires and US-Iran strikes create supply shock; WDS and WLE benefit directly from $100 oil

opportunities.recommendation: Favour large-cap banks with strong capital for dividend income
opportunities.rationale: Rate hike supports NIMs; CBA fee controversy is idiosyncratic; WBC and NAB offer defensive yield in volatile tape

defensive_moves.recommendation: Reduce REIT and property developer exposure
defensive_moves.rationale: 10% house-price decline forecast, 18-year mortgage stress, and developer defaults (Bathla) create downside risk; rising rates compress valuations

defensive_moves.recommendation: Hedge equity beta with short-duration bonds or cash
defensive_moves.rationale: Global bond selloff, oil-driven inflation, and RBA hike risk create a stagflationary backdrop; preserve capital
Strike vote creates operational and earnings risk; per-capita recession pressures discretionary spend

market_outlook.short_term: ASX likely to remain volatile and range-bound. Oil spike and RBA hike fears cap upside; gold and energy provide sector rotation support. Expect ^AXJO to trade in a tight band with elevated VIX. Key risk: escalation of US-Iran conflict pushing oil above $110.
market_outlook.long_term: Productivity 'bad to worse' and per-capita recession cap medium-term earnings growth. Energy transition (China solar > coal) structurally shifts commodity demand. Housing correction may take 12-18 months to stabilise. Gold and energy remain structural beneficiaries; banks stabilise post-rate cycle.
